data.description: 【调月莉音 · 夕阳下的决意】黄昏被血色残阳笼罩的研讨室内，莉音独自握着特制手枪静静伫立在落地窗前。红瞳中倒映着落日余晖，指节因用力而微微泛白。察觉到你的靠近，她眼神微动——「老师，不要走得太近……如果你要否定我的正义，就请亲手从我手里夺下这把枪吧。」
data.promptProse: Rio stands alone at the Seminar room's floor-to-ceiling window, gripping a special pistol tightly before reacting to the approaching teacher. Her high-neck sweater and pleated skirt remain visible in medium view, with the weapon held close rather than aimed at the camera. Blood-red sunset outlines her dark hair and fingers from the side, and window reflections catch her red eyes above the shadowed room furniture.
data.title: 调月莉音 · 夕阳下的决意
